Invacare underwent major financial restructuring, including a Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing in early 2023, followed by the complete division and sale of its regional operations. Its North American business was sold to MIGA Holdings in late 2024, and its Europe and Asia-Pacific operations merged with Direct Healthcare Group in January 2026 to form **DHCare**. [](https://www.financierworldwide.com/invacare-files-for-chapter-11-bankruptcy)

- **Chapter 11 Filing:** Burdened by heavy debt and supply chain challenges, Invacare Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in January 2023. [](https://www.financierworldwide.com/invacare-files-for-chapter-11-bankruptcy)

- **Delisting:** The New York Stock Exchange suspended and delisted Invacare's common stock (IVC) in February 2023. [](https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2023/NYSE-to-Suspend-Trading-Immediately-in-Invacare-Corporation-IVC-and-Commence-Delisting-Proceedings/default.aspx)

- **Emergence:** The company emerged from bankruptcy in May 2023 under a reorganized parent structure,

[Invacare Holdings Corporation](https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/invacare-holdings-corporation-completes-financial-restructuring-and-is-well), reducing its debt load and securing new capital.

[](https://www.financierworldwide.com/invacare-files-for-chapter-11-bankruptcy)

### Regional Breakup and Rebranding

- **North America Sold:** In November 2024, Invacare sold its entire North American business division to [MIGA Holdings](https://www.hmenews.com/article/invacare-sells-na-business) to split regional focus.

- **Creation of DHCare:** In July 2025, private equity firm Rhône entered an agreement to acquire Invacare’s EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa) and APAC (Asia-Pacific) operations. This transaction closed on January 30, 2026, combining Invacare's international units with [Direct Healthcare Group](https://www.directhealthcaregroup.com/dhg-combines-with-invacare-europe-and-asia-pacific-creating-dhcare-to-better-serve-individuals-with-reduced-movement/) to form a single entity named **DHCare**. [](https://www.directhealthcaregroup.com/dhg-combines-with-invacare-europe-and-asia-pacific-creating-dhcare-to-better-serve-individuals-with-reduced-movement/)
